name: habit-shaper
description: A lightweight daily habit building and breaking application.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @habit-shaper/contracts && npm run build --workspace @habit-shaper/api && npm run build --workspace @habit-shaper/web
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @habit-shaper/api" "npm run dev --workspace @habit-shaper/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api:unit
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @habit-shaper/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @habit-shaper/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @habit-shaper/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @habit-shaper/e2e
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
